text.tspan: Blessing of the Trinity — His Revelation
As “I AM THAT I AM” to us,
The God of old, of Abraham,
Of Isaac, Jacob—the I AM! (God is!)
Jehovah cause His face to shine,
And lift His countenance on thine!” (Amen!)
The shining Triune God is not for doctrine,
The shining Triune God is for dispensing!
He is now dispensing; He is now dispensing
In you and me, in you and me!
“Whom shall I send? Whom shall I send?
And, who will go, will go for Us?”
The Triune God now calls to us! (Send us!)
Into the Name of Father, Son,
The living Triune God is not for doctrine,
The living Triune God is for dispensing!
He is now dispensing; He is now dispensing
In you and me, in you and me!
In Paul’s epistles, here we find:
The love of God, the grace of Christ,
In spirit now this blessing’s mine! (Amen!)
We kneeling ask our Father, thus:
Oh, through Your Spirit strengthen us
With pow’r into our inner man,
So Christ can make His home within! (My heart!)
The moving Triune God is not for doctrine,
The moving Triune God is for dispensing!
He is now dispensing; He is now dispensing
In you and me, in you and me!
Now to the Triune God we sing:
“Who was and is, and is coming,
The seven Spirits by the throne,
The Witness True and Son Firstborn!” (Praise Him!)
The processed Triune God is not for doctrine,
The processed Triune God is for dispensing!
He is now dispensing; He is now dispensing
In you and me, in you and me!
